verdict_rule: GO only if every hard gate passes on the sleeve's path (live_edge or two_stage); FORWARD_TEST_PASS caps forward tests; BETA_SLEEVE for no-edge sleeves; NOT_ELIGIBLE for exits_only/quarantined; no percentage score. Real capital remains a human decision.
